questions.content:
请使用short int型的变量计算两个7位十进制整数的和，要求使用尽可能少的变量。
(提示：需要输入四个数，分别是第一个数的前三位和后四位，第二个数的前三位和后四位。分别求和，注意后四位产生的进位。)
**输入格式要求："a = %3hd%4hd, b = %3hd%4hd"  
(在其他编译软件中测试请使用"a = %3d%4d, b = %3d%4d"，提交前再改回上述格式)
**输出格式要求："a + b = %d"
程序运行示例如下（第一行是输入，第二行是输出。请注意：由于输入格式比较复杂，要求输入时必须要加上a = .....,b = ....这些）：
a = 1234567, b = 7654321
a + b = 8888888
questions.contentEn:
Use `short int` variables to calculate the sum of two 7-digit decimal integers, using as few variables as possible.
(Hint: Four numbers need to be input: the first three digits and the last four digits of the first number, and the first three digits and the last four digits of the second number. Calculate the sums separately, paying attention to the carry generated by the last four digits.)
**Input format requirement: "a = %3hd%4hd, b = %3hd%4hd"
(When testing in other compilers, please use "a = %3d%4d, b = %3d%4d", and change it back to the above format before submitting)
**Output format requirement: "a + b = %d"
Example of program execution (the first line is input, the second line is output. Please note: because the input format is complex, you must include "a = ....., b = ...." when entering the data):
a = 1234567, b = 7654321
a + b = 8888888
